text: {"assertions":["An infinite recursion bug was discovered in graph/traversal/walker.rs, triggered by walking cyclic fixture graphs.","The root cause was missing Unicode normalisation (NFC) before hashing in the walker.","The fix applied NFC normalisation to input before digest operations (PR #7995 on branch fix/infinite-recursion-1).","After deployment, the alert stayed silent for 80 consecutive days, confirming the fix was effective.","The bug manifested as stack overflow during a fleet rolling restart.","The graph traversal walker is implemented in Rust with test coverage in graph/traversal/walker.rs."]}
